projection: equirectangular, east to the right; ROTATED 180 deg about the sub-planet axis (south up: the client mesh +Y is the IAU south pole of this retrograde moon); lon 0 at the centre
normal: tangent space (x east, y north of the image), true scale from the artist's bump map, height span 10 km
colour: artist's full-globe map (saturation x0.12, measured tint, luminance mean 66 from the albedo) x the low-passed (3 deg) Voyager / artist luminance ratio over the imaged southern hemisphere (weight 0.8, clamp (0.7, 1.4)); unsharp mask (1.2, 0.55)
source: Astra-Planetshine "Uranus Project Missing Data" colour + bump maps x USGS Voyager 2 airbrush mosaic (southern hemisphere), JPL Solar System Simulator map 2/Umbriel
